traditions.VUL: Et venit Hánani , unus de frátribus meis , ipse
traditions.KJV: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄνδρες Ἰούδα ,
traditions.KJV: he and [ certain ] men of Judah ;

traditions.KJV: and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped ,

2.english_reference: which were left of the captivity

traditions.LXX: καὶ περὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.KJV: and concerning Jerusalem .

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴποσαν πρὸς μέ
traditions.KJV: And they said unto me ,

traditions.KJV: The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province [ are ] in great affliction and reproach :

3.english_reference: the wall of Jerusalem also [ is ] broken down

traditions.KJV: the wall of Jerusalem also [ is ] broken down ,

traditions.VUL: et portæ eius combústæ sunt igni .
traditions.KJV: and the gates thereof are burned with fire .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί με τοὺς λόγους τούτους
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , when I heard these words ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶתְאַבְּלָ֖ ה יָמִ֑ים

traditions.VUL: ieiunábam , et orábam ante fáciem Dei cæli .
traditions.KJV: and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֗ר אָֽנָּ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ שָּׁמַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα Μὴ δή , Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

traditions.LXX: ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ μέγας καὶ φοβερός ,
traditions.KJV: the great and terrible God ,

5.english_reference: that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments

traditions.KJV: that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments :

6.english_reference: Let thine ear now be attentive , and thine eyes open

traditions.KJV: Let thine ear now be attentive , and thine eyes open ,

6.english_reference: that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant

traditions.KJV: that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant ,

traditions.VUL: quam ego oro coram te hódie nocte et die pro fíliis Israel servis tuis :
traditions.KJV: which I pray before thee now , day and night , for the children of Israel thy servants ,

6.english_reference: and confess the sins of the children of Israel , which we have sinned against thee

traditions.VUL: et confíteor pro peccátis filiórum Israel , quibus peccavérunt tibi :
traditions.KJV: and confess the sins of the children of Israel , which we have sinned against thee :

traditions.VUL: ego et domus patris mei peccávimus ,

traditions.LXX: διαλύσει διελύσαμεν ,

traditions.KJV: and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments ,

traditions.KJV: Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֣ם תִּמְעָ֔לוּ

traditions.LXX: ἐκεῖθεν συνάξω αὐτούς ,

traditions.KJV: and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there .

traditions.LXX: μὴ δή ,
traditions.KJV: O Lord , I beseech thee ,

traditions.KJV: let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant ,

traditions.KJV: who desire to fear thy name :

traditions.KJV: and grant him mercy in the sight of this man .

11.english_reference: For I was the king ’s cupbearer .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην εὐνοῦχος τῷ βασιλεῖ .
traditions.KJV: For I was the king ’s cupbearer .
